targeting.title: Ollama Models Folder on Windows: Find It and Move It to Another Drive
targeting.metaTitle: Ollama Models Folder on Windows: Move It to Another Drive
targeting.metaDescription: Where Ollama stores models on Windows, how to move them to another drive without re-downloading, and why OLLAMA_MODELS gets ignored by the app's Model location.
targeting.excerpt: Ollama keeps every model in C:\Users\<you>\.ollama\models until you tell it otherwise. Here is the exact folder layout, how to move existing models to another drive without downloading them again, and the Settings → Model location override that makes OLLAMA_MODELS look ignored.
secondary: move ollama models to another drive windows
targeting.author: Ali Rehman
targeting.keywords: ollama models folder windows, ollama models location windows, ollama change model folder windows, move ollama models to another drive, OLLAMA_MODELS not working, ollama model location setting, ollama blobs manifests, ollama list empty
targeting.summary: The models folder is the one that directly contains blobs and manifests; pointing OLLAMA_MODELS at the parent .ollama folder empties ollama list|Move existing models with robocopy after quitting the tray app, then set OLLAMA_MODELS and the app's Settings → Model location to the identical path|The server config line in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Ollama\server.log shows which folder the running server actually uses
